context: A parent-teacher-doctor meeting about Sho's overall wellbeing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日は、お時間、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Thank you so much for taking time to see us today.
lines.style: Warm, respectful opening. Gentle exhale on gratitude. Measured pace. The composure of someone who has prepared what to say, but means every word.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: しょうくん、本当に、健康そのもの。安心です。
lines.en: Sho really is the picture of health. It's reassuring to see.
lines.style: Professional warmth with genuine relief underneath. Clear, steady delivery. Slight soften on his name. The tone of a doctor reporting good news she's genuinely pleased to deliver.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 学校でも、成長を、感じてます。お友達も、増えて。
lines.en: At school, we're seeing real growth. He's made more friends too.
lines.style: Warm observational tone. Slight lift on the positive updates. Patient pauses between clauses — giving space for each piece of good news to land. Genuine appreciation in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本当にありがたい。皆さんに、見守られて。
lines.en: I'm truly grateful. He's being cared for by all of you.
lines.style: Quiet, sincere. Let the gratitude breathe. Slight tremor of emotion held steady. The voice of someone who knows what good support means and won't take it for granted.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: お母様の、ご家庭での支えが、何より大事。
lines.en: The support you provide at home is what makes the real difference.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Emphasis gentle but certain on the word 'home'. The candor of professional respect — acknowledging what she sees working behind the scenes.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: こうやって、皆で、しょうくんを、応援していけるの、嬉しい。
lines.en: It's wonderful to be able to support Sho together like this.
lines.style: Warm, reflective. Open on the opening word. Slight lift toward 'wonderful'. Genuine pleasure in the idea of shared care — not performative, but clearly felt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Quiet, brief closing. Each word carries weight. No rush. The kind of thanks that doesn't need elaboration.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: これからも、ちゃんと、見守っていきましょう。
lines.en: Let's continue to watch over him carefully from here on.
lines.style: Professional assurance. Steady, forward-looking tone. The commitment of someone saying 'I will be here'. Calm, reliable, no flourish.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 一緒に、見守れること、私も、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm happy too — being able to support him alongside all of you.
lines.style: Warm, personal beneath the professional. Slight lean forward on 'happy'. Genuine pleasure in being part of something larger than just teacher-student.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: これからも、よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: Thank you for everything. Please continue to guide us.
lines.style: Formal respect with genuine warmth underneath. Measured, deliberate. The careful courtesy of someone honoring a relationship that matters beyond what politeness requires.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: こちらこそ。家族みたいに、ね。
lines.en: The same to you. Like family, you know?
lines.style: Warm, slightly softer than before. Light touch of intimacy on 'like family'. A brief expansion — moving from professional to something more genuine. Quiet significance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本当に。ずっと、繋がっていきたい。
lines.en: Yes. I hope we stay connected like this always.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. No hesitation. Open, vulnerable quality — speaking something she clearly means. Slight trailing warmth on the final word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: こうやって、皆さんに、囲まれていて、本当に、幸せ。
lines.en: Being surrounded by all of you — I'm truly happy.
lines.style: Warm, contemplative closing. Soft opening on 'being'. The gratitude of someone who recognizes something rare. Slight catch of emotion held gently. Settling tone at the end.
